---
id: env.def.clean-up-costs
type: definition
heading: Clean-up Costs
since: 1.0.0
status: draft
---

Reasonable and necessary costs to investigate, test, monitor, contain, remove, treat, neutralise or dispose of pollutants, and to restore property damaged by doing so to substantially its condition before the pollution condition, where:

- environmental law requires the work, or a government authority directs or orders it under environmental law; or
- the work is needed to meet a claim by a third party for property damage covered by this policy.

They do not include costs to improve property beyond its condition before the pollution condition, your own salaries, overheads or internal costs, or the costs of complying with a licence, approval or permit in the ordinary course of your business.
